track2_template_fields.A1: Methods description — MVA Hackathon 2026, Track 2 (Drug Repurposing)
track2_template_fields.A2:
Please submit your answers with your Track 2 report. All questions (with the exception of Question 1, in red) are voluntary; however, submissions without a methods description may be judged less favorably on the Scientific Rigor and Innovation criteria, since the panel can't assess what it can't see.

Track 2 accepts one final submission per team.
track2_template_fields.A8: Please describe your approach in detail (how you went from variant/mechanism to candidate medication(s)).
track2_template_fields.A9: (required) If commercially-available Generative AI was used, record the provider, the plan or tier, and the relevant setting in your methods description. A line is enough, for example, "Anthropic API, Claude Sonnet, commercial terms, no training on customer content."
track2_template_fields.A10: Was candidate identification automated (e.g., via a drug-target database query or LLM-assisted search), or primarily manual literature review and expert curation?
track2_template_fields.A11: Please describe any manual literature review or expert curation in detail.
track2_template_fields.A12: Please state whether you relied solely on publicly available drug/target databases and literature (preferred), or whether proprietary data sources were also used.
track2_template_fields.A13: Please describe the public data sources used in detail (e.g., DrugBank, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, OMIM, PubMed literature search).
track2_template_fields.A14: Please describe any proprietary data sources used in detail.
track2_template_fields.A15: How did you characterize the variant's mechanism (e.g., loss-of-function vs. gain-of-function, pathway disrupted, downstream biological consequence)?
track2_template_fields.A16: Please provide an estimate of time or effort spent on this analysis (if possible).
track2_template_fields.A17: Provide a method abstract (up to 500 words). Please include strengths and limitations of your approach as well as methodological detail.
